attributes.title: [SRE] OpenSearch Fleet
attributes.description: Domain-grain fleet table for standup. Yellow/red, used-space %, JVM, CPU, rejects, HTTP 5xx, unassigned shards, writes-blocked, snapshot. Default last 6 hours.
